command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ps=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'); foreach(`$p in `$ps){ foreach(`$n in @('PE1','PE2','PE3','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02')){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u).output; Write-Output ('### '+`$p+'/'+`$n); (`$o -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object {`$_ -match '(^stp enable`$|ospf cost|isis cost|ip route-static 160|stp instance [0-9]+ port priority)'} } }"
